filter_lcov_branch_coverage: filter an lcov trace file to remove branch data for lines without conditional statements
skip_comments_from_lines: remove C-style single line and multi-line comments from a stream of source code lines
find_conditional_lines: find line numbers containing bare if conditional statements in preprocessed source code
find_conditional_lines_from_file: find line numbers of conditional statements in a source file after stripping comments
run_filterbr_cli: run the filterbr script on an lcov trace file and print filtered output to stdout
